aspect: The waiting is the first part of the illness
description: Symptom, GP, referral, waiting list, scan, waiting list, result. Months in which nothing is known and everything is suspected, before any treatment begins.
energy_note: Ill, untreated, and not yet allowed to be a patient.

aspect: It is not caused by anything you did
description: Most serious diagnoses come with no behavioural explanation available to the person receiving them, which removes the one form of control people reach for.
energy_note: No story to tell yourself about why.

aspect: Treatment is a job with a rota
description: Appointments, scans, infusions, bloods, reviews - scheduled by the hospital, not by you, across months, each one a day.
energy_note: A calendar written by someone else.

description: Three weeks between the scan and the result. She works, eats and sleeps badly through all of it. The result is benign. Nothing happened, and the three weeks are gone.
energy_note: Healthy, and it still cost a month.

description: A diagnosis draws a partner, parents and children into caring, worrying and rearranging. None of them chose it either.

aspect: Chronic means there is no after
description: For a condition managed rather than cured, there is no point at which the appointments, medication and monitoring stop.
energy_note: Not a crisis. A permanent second occupation.
